# `aitbc oracle store`

Announce a CID for sale on the local data oracle.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc oracle store [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--cid` | text | — | yes | Content identifier to announce |
| `--price` | text | — | yes | Price for the data set (in AIT) |
| `--description` | text | — | no | Description of the data |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc oracle store --cid <cid> --price <price>
```
